label: ESTIMATE
caveat: Hit counts come from the AUDITED SAMPLE only: 150 detected moments across 54 audited transcripts, of which 98 no-search moments were measured here (96 judged, 2 skipped). Corpus-wide hit numbers extrapolate the per-transcript sample rate to the 568-transcript corpus (x10.52) and assume the audited transcripts are representative -- they are labeled ESTIMATE, not measured. Detected moments are themselves a lower bound (the moment detector is not exhaustive). Per-failure-event fires corpus-wide are also extrapolated (moments exist only for the audited sample).

per_failure_event.fires_sample_provenance: DERIVED (failure/rework/correction moments in the 150-moment sample; itself a lower bound on real failure events)
per_failure_event.fires_corpus_provenance: ESTIMATE (sample rate x 10.52 -- no corpus-wide failure-event count exists)

per_dispatch_event.fires_sample_provenance: DERIVED (dispatch_events in the audited transcripts, transcript-events.jsonl)
per_dispatch_event.hits_definition: cue_present_missed moments of moment_type == dispatch (no dispatch-specific cue exists in the current guidance; this counts missed-cue moments a dispatch-time fire would reach)
